title: Backend Observations
description: Per-backend execution metrics collected during a single run. A run may produce multiple backend observation rows when multiple backends are tested sequentially. Keyed on (run_id, backend).

run_id.description: Foreign key into the runs table. Combined with backend to form the composite key.

tokens_per_second.description: Median generation throughput for this backend in tokens per second.

ttft_ms.description: Median time-to-first-token in milliseconds for this backend.

peak_memory_mb.description: Peak memory usage during generation in megabytes for this backend.

warmup_tokens.description: Number of warmup tokens used before measurement began.

measurement_clock.description: Clock source used for timing measurements.

num_repetitions.description: Number of independent repetitions used for this backend.

aggregation_method.description: Statistical method used to aggregate multiple repetitions.
